_comment: Sets and printings that shipped in an earlier bundle and must keep shipping after YGOPRODeck drops or re-codes them. Dropping one makes SetSyncService's stale-row cleanup delete users' pulled cards (CLAUDE.md decision #7). build_bundle.py re-adds anything here that the fresh build lacks; entries the fresh build already has are left alone.

DPC5._why: 2026-10: YGOPRODeck re-coded Duelist Pack Collection Tin 2011 to DPCT, where the larger 2010 tin wins the set_code dedup.
